asset.name: Morpho

score_rationales.regulatory: DeFi lending, institutional backing signals compliance
score_rationales.supply: MORPHO is hard-capped at 1,000,000,000 tokens (Morpho governance FAQ) with CoinGecko-consistent circulation near ~606M (~60.6% of supply), so a large share is already liquid under disclosed cohort vesting rather than unlimited inflation. DeFiLlama’s unlock view still flags ongoing daily releases from strategic-partner and founder schedules (on the order of hundreds of thousands of MORPHO per day combined), and public top-holder snapshots remain very concentrated—much of it labeled treasuries/contracts but still not broadly decentralized float. Governance voting locks some usage but does not act like a large, yield-backed staking sink that materially removes sell-side pressure.
score_rationales.wyckoff: Wyckoff phase carried from last snapshot until the next daily indicators refresh.
score_rationales.adoption_activity: DefiLlama (May 2026) shows Morpho at roughly $7.29B TVL with major depth on Ethereum and Base and deployment across Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, Polygon, Hyperliquid L1, Monad, Katana, and others; about $4B on the borrowed side shows lending is actively drawn, not passive TVL. That scale and multi-chain, curator-driven vault usage place Morpho among the most-used modular lending stacks in DeFi, though it remains smaller than the largest monolithic lenders.
